_README: Human-verified NCERT Hindi chapter titles in Devanagari Unicode. Checked FIRST by scripts/extract-hindi-titles.js and always beats the PDF layout parser, because a title read by a person is trustworthy and one inferred from font sizes is not. Anything absent falls through to an honest 'Chapter N' placeholder.
_keys: Either a book code (kham1) or a readable name containing the grade and 'hindi' (g11_hindi_aroh). Both resolve. Chapter keys are ch1, ch2, ...
